+import type { SessionInfo, AccountView } from "./api";
+
+export interface AuthenticatedAccountProfile {
+  displayName?: string | null;
+  handle?: string | null;
+  avatarUrl?: string | null;
+  email?: string | null;
+}
+
+export type SessionInfoWithProfile = SessionInfo & {
+  profile?: AuthenticatedAccountProfile | null;
+};
+
+export interface AccountDisplay {
+  name: string;
+  secondary: string;
+  initials: string;
+  avatarUrl: string | null;
+  privateEmail: string | null;
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayForSession(session: SessionInfo | null): AccountDisplay {
+  return accountDisplayFromSources({ session });
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayFromSources({
+  session,
+  account,
+}: {
+  session: SessionInfo | null;
+  account?: AccountView | null;
+}): AccountDisplay {
+  const sessionWithProfile = session as SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  const profile = sessionWithProfile?.profile ?? null;
+  const privateEmail = normalizeEmail(profile?.email);
+  const handle = normalizeHandle(profile?.handle) ?? normalizeHandle(account?.account?.handle);
+  const displayName = normalizeDisplayName(profile?.displayName, privateEmail);
+  const did = sessionWithProfile?.did ?? account?.account?.did ?? null;
+  const name = displayName ?? handle ?? "Signed-in account";
+  const secondary = handle && handle !== name ? handle : shortenDid(did) ?? "Not Organic";
+
+  return {
+    name,
+    secondary,
+    initials: initialsFor(displayName ?? handle ?? did),
+    avatarUrl: safeAvatarUrl(profile?.avatarUrl),
+    privateEmail,
+  };
+}
+
+function normalizeDisplayName(value: unknown, email: string | null): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (email && text.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) return null;
+  if (looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeHandle(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value)?.replace(/^@+/, "");
+  if (!text || looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeEmail(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  return text && looksLikeEmail(text) ? text : null;
+}
+
+function normalizeText(value: unknown): string | null {
+  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null;
+}
+
+function safeAvatarUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.startsWith("/") && !text.startsWith("//")) return text;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(text);
+    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.toString() : null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function looksLikeEmail(value: string): boolean {
+  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
+}
+
+function initialsFor(value: string | null | undefined): string {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return "NO";
+  const words = text
+    .replace(/^did:\w+:/, "")
+    .split(/[\s._-]+/)
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  const first = words[0] ?? text;
+  const second = words.find((word) => word !== first);
+  return [first, second]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .map((word) => Array.from(word)[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
+    .join("")
+    .slice(0, 2) || "NO";
+}
+
+function shortenDid(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.length <= 24) return text;
+  return `${text.slice(0, 13)}...${text.slice(-6)}`;
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+import type { SessionInfo, AccountView } from "./api";
+
+export interface AuthenticatedAccountProfile {
+  displayName?: string | null;
+  handle?: string | null;
+  avatarUrl?: string | null;
+  email?: string | null;
+}
+
+export type SessionInfoWithProfile = SessionInfo & {
+  profile?: AuthenticatedAccountProfile | null;
+};
+
+export interface AccountDisplay {
+  name: string;
+  secondary: string;
+  initials: string;
+  avatarUrl: string | null;
+  privateEmail: string | null;
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayForSession(session: SessionInfo | null): AccountDisplay {
+  return accountDisplayFromSources({ session });
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayFromSources({
+  session,
+  account,
+}: {
+  session: SessionInfo | null;
+  account?: AccountView | null;
+}): AccountDisplay {
+  const sessionWithProfile = session as SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  const profile = sessionWithProfile?.profile ?? null;
+  const privateEmail = normalizeEmail(profile?.email);
+  const handle = normalizeHandle(profile?.handle) ?? normalizeHandle(account?.account?.handle);
+  const displayName = normalizeDisplayName(profile?.displayName, privateEmail);
+  const did = sessionWithProfile?.did ?? account?.account?.did ?? null;
+  const name = displayName ?? handle ?? "Signed-in account";
+  const secondary = handle && handle !== name ? handle : shortenDid(did) ?? "Not Organic";
+
+  return {
+    name,
+    secondary,
+    initials: initialsFor(displayName ?? handle ?? did),
+    avatarUrl: safeAvatarUrl(profile?.avatarUrl),
+    privateEmail,
+  };
+}
+
+function normalizeDisplayName(value: unknown, email: string | null): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (email && text.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) return null;
+  if (looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeHandle(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value)?.replace(/^@+/, "");
+  if (!text || looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeEmail(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  return text && looksLikeEmail(text) ? text : null;
+}
+
+function normalizeText(value: unknown): string | null {
+  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null;
+}
+
+function safeAvatarUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.startsWith("/") && !text.startsWith("//")) return text;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(text);
+    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.toString() : null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function looksLikeEmail(value: string): boolean {
+  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
+}
+
+function initialsFor(value: string | null | undefined): string {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return "NO";
+  const words = text
+    .replace(/^did:\w+:/, "")
+    .split(/[\s._-]+/)
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  const first = words[0] ?? text;
+  const second = words.find((word) => word !== first);
+  return [first, second]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .map((word) => Array.from(word)[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
+    .join("")
+    .slice(0, 2) || "NO";
+}
+
+function shortenDid(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.length <= 24) return text;
+  return `${text.slice(0, 13)}...${text.slice(-6)}`;
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+import type { SessionInfo, AccountView } from "./api";
+
+export interface AuthenticatedAccountProfile {
+  displayName?: string | null;
+  handle?: string | null;
+  avatarUrl?: string | null;
+  email?: string | null;
+}
+
+export type SessionInfoWithProfile = SessionInfo & {
+  profile?: AuthenticatedAccountProfile | null;
+};
+
+export interface AccountDisplay {
+  name: string;
+  secondary: string;
+  initials: string;
+  avatarUrl: string | null;
+  privateEmail: string | null;
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayForSession(session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null): AccountDisplay {
+  return accountDisplayFromSources({ session });
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayFromSources({
+  session,
+  account,
+}: {
+  session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  account?: AccountView | null;
+}): AccountDisplay {
+  const sessionWithProfile = session as SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  const profile = sessionWithProfile?.profile ?? null;
+  const privateEmail = normalizeEmail(profile?.email);
+  const handle = normalizeHandle(profile?.handle) ?? normalizeHandle(account?.account?.handle);
+  const displayName = normalizeDisplayName(profile?.displayName, privateEmail);
+  const did = sessionWithProfile?.did ?? account?.account?.did ?? null;
+  const name = displayName ?? handle ?? "Signed-in account";
+  const secondary = handle && handle !== name ? handle : shortenDid(did) ?? "Not Organic";
+
+  return {
+    name,
+    secondary,
+    initials: initialsFor(displayName ?? handle ?? did),
+    avatarUrl: safeAvatarUrl(profile?.avatarUrl),
+    privateEmail,
+  };
+}
+
+function normalizeDisplayName(value: unknown, email: string | null): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (email && text.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) return null;
+  if (looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeHandle(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value)?.replace(/^@+/, "");
+  if (!text || looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeEmail(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  return text && looksLikeEmail(text) ? text : null;
+}
+
+function normalizeText(value: unknown): string | null {
+  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null;
+}
+
+function safeAvatarUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.startsWith("/") && !text.startsWith("//")) return text;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(text);
+    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.toString() : null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function looksLikeEmail(value: string): boolean {
+  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
+}
+
+function initialsFor(value: string | null | undefined): string {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return "NO";
+  const words = text
+    .replace(/^did:\w+:/, "")
+    .split(/[\s._-]+/)
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  const first = words[0] ?? text;
+  const second = words.find((word) => word !== first);
+  return [first, second]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .map((word) => Array.from(word ?? "")[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
+    .join("")
+    .slice(0, 2) || "NO";
+}
+
+function shortenDid(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.length <= 24) return text;
+  return `${text.slice(0, 13)}...${text.slice(-6)}`;
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+import type { SessionInfo, AccountView } from "./api";
+
+export interface AuthenticatedAccountProfile {
+  displayName?: string | null;
+  handle?: string | null;
+  avatarUrl?: string | null;
+  email?: string | null;
+}
+
+export type SessionInfoWithProfile = SessionInfo & {
+  profile?: AuthenticatedAccountProfile | null;
+};
+
+export interface AccountDisplay {
+  name: string;
+  secondary: string;
+  initials: string;
+  avatarUrl: string | null;
+  privateEmail: string | null;
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayForSession(session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null): AccountDisplay {
+  return accountDisplayFromSources({ session });
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayFromSources({
+  session,
+  account,
+}: {
+  session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  account?: AccountView | null;
+}): AccountDisplay {
+  const sessionWithProfile = session as SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  const profile = sessionWithProfile?.profile ?? null;
+  const privateEmail = normalizeEmail(profile?.email);
+  const handle = normalizeHandle(profile?.handle) ?? normalizeHandle(account?.account?.handle);
+  const displayName = normalizeDisplayName(profile?.displayName, privateEmail);
+  const did = sessionWithProfile?.did ?? account?.account?.did ?? null;
+  const name = displayName ?? handle ?? "Signed-in account";
+  const secondary = handle && handle !== name ? handle : shortenDid(did) ?? "Not Organic";
+
+  return {
+    name,
+    secondary,
+    initials: initialsFor(displayName ?? handle ?? did),
+    avatarUrl: safeAvatarUrl(profile?.avatarUrl),
+    privateEmail,
+  };
+}
+
+function normalizeDisplayName(value: unknown, email: string | null): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (email && text.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) return null;
+  if (looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeHandle(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value)?.replace(/^@+/, "");
+  if (!text || looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeEmail(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  return text && looksLikeEmail(text) ? text : null;
+}
+
+function normalizeText(value: unknown): string | null {
+  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null;
+}
+
+function safeAvatarUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.startsWith("/") && !text.startsWith("//")) return text;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(text);
+    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.toString() : null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function looksLikeEmail(value: string): boolean {
+  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
+}
+
+function initialsFor(value: string | null | undefined): string {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return "NO";
+  const words = text
+    .replace(/^did:\w+:/, "")
+    .split(/[\s._-]+/)
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  const first = words[0] ?? text;
+  const second = words.find((word) => word !== first);
+  return [first, second]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .map((word) => Array.from(word ?? "")[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
+    .join("")
+    .slice(0, 2) || "NO";
+}
+
+function shortenDid(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.length <= 24) return text;
+  return `${text.slice(0, 13)}...${text.slice(-6)}`;
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+import type { SessionInfo, AccountView } from "./api";
+
+export interface AuthenticatedAccountProfile {
+  displayName?: string | null;
+  handle?: string | null;
+  avatarUrl?: string | null;
+  email?: string | null;
+}
+
+export type SessionInfoWithProfile = SessionInfo & {
+  profile?: AuthenticatedAccountProfile | null;
+};
+
+export interface AccountDisplay {
+  name: string;
+  secondary: string;
+  initials: string;
+  avatarUrl: string | null;
+  privateEmail: string | null;
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayForSession(session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null): AccountDisplay {
+  return accountDisplayFromSources({ session });
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayFromSources({
+  session,
+  account,
+}: {
+  session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  account?: AccountView | null;
+}): AccountDisplay {
+  const sessionWithProfile = session as SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  const profile = sessionWithProfile?.profile ?? null;
+  const privateEmail = normalizeEmail(profile?.email);
+  const handle = normalizeHandle(profile?.handle) ?? normalizeHandle(account?.account?.handle);
+  const displayName = normalizeDisplayName(profile?.displayName, privateEmail);
+  const did = sessionWithProfile?.did ?? account?.account?.did ?? null;
+  const name = displayName ?? handle ?? "Signed-in account";
+  const secondary = handle && handle !== name ? handle : shortenDid(did) ?? "Not Organic";
+
+  return {
+    name,
+    secondary,
+    initials: initialsFor(displayName ?? handle ?? did),
+    avatarUrl: safeAvatarUrl(profile?.avatarUrl),
+    privateEmail,
+  };
+}
+
+function normalizeDisplayName(value: unknown, email: string | null): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (email && text.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) return null;
+  if (looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeHandle(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value)?.replace(/^@+/, "");
+  if (!text || looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeEmail(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  return text && looksLikeEmail(text) ? text : null;
+}
+
+function normalizeText(value: unknown): string | null {
+  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null;
+}
+
+function safeAvatarUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.startsWith("/") && !text.startsWith("//")) return text;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(text);
+    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.toString() : null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function looksLikeEmail(value: string): boolean {
+  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
+}
+
+function initialsFor(value: string | null | undefined): string {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return "NO";
+  const words = text
+    .replace(/^did:\w+:/, "")
+    .split(/[\s._-]+/)
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  const first = words[0] ?? text;
+  const second = words.find((word) => word !== first);
+  return [first, second]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .map((word) => Array.from(word ?? "")[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
+    .join("")
+    .slice(0, 2) || "NO";
+}
+
+function shortenDid(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.length <= 24) return text;
+  return `${text.slice(0, 13)}...${text.slice(-6)}`;
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+import type { SessionInfo, AccountView } from "./api";
+
+export interface AuthenticatedAccountProfile {
+  displayName?: string | null;
+  handle?: string | null;
+  avatarUrl?: string | null;
+  email?: string | null;
+}
+
+export type SessionInfoWithProfile = SessionInfo & {
+  profile?: AuthenticatedAccountProfile | null;
+};
+
+export interface AccountDisplay {
+  name: string;
+  secondary: string;
+  initials: string;
+  avatarUrl: string | null;
+  privateEmail: string | null;
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayForSession(session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null): AccountDisplay {
+  return accountDisplayFromSources({ session });
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayFromSources({
+  session,
+  account,
+}: {
+  session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  account?: AccountView | null;
+}): AccountDisplay {
+  const sessionWithProfile = session as SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  const profile = sessionWithProfile?.profile ?? null;
+  const privateEmail = normalizeEmail(profile?.email);
+  const handle = normalizeHandle(profile?.handle) ?? normalizeHandle(account?.account?.handle);
+  const displayName = normalizeDisplayName(profile?.displayName, privateEmail);
+  const did = sessionWithProfile?.did ?? account?.account?.did ?? null;
+  const name = displayName ?? handle ?? "Signed-in account";
+  const secondary = handle && handle !== name ? handle : shortenDid(did) ?? "Not Organic";
+
+  return {
+    name,
+    secondary,
+    initials: initialsFor(displayName ?? handle ?? did),
+    avatarUrl: safeAvatarUrl(profile?.avatarUrl),
+    privateEmail,
+  };
+}
+
+function normalizeDisplayName(value: unknown, email: string | null): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (email && text.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) return null;
+  if (looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeHandle(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value)?.replace(/^@+/, "");
+  if (!text || looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeEmail(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  return text && looksLikeEmail(text) ? text : null;
+}
+
+function normalizeText(value: unknown): string | null {
+  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null;
+}
+
+function safeAvatarUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.startsWith("/") && !text.startsWith("//")) return text;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(text);
+    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.toString() : null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function looksLikeEmail(value: string): boolean {
+  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
+}
+
+function initialsFor(value: string | null | undefined): string {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return "NO";
+  const words = text
+    .replace(/^did:\w+:/, "")
+    .split(/[\s._-]+/)
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  const first = words[0] ?? text;
+  const second = words.find((word) => word !== first);
+  return [first, second]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .map((word) => Array.from(word ?? "")[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
+    .join("")
+    .slice(0, 2) || "NO";
+}
+
+function shortenDid(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.length <= 24) return text;
+  return `${text.slice(0, 13)}...${text.slice(-6)}`;
+}

+import type { SessionInfo, AccountView } from "./api";
+
+export interface AuthenticatedAccountProfile {
+  displayName?: string | null;
+  handle?: string | null;
+  avatarUrl?: string | null;
+  email?: string | null;
+}
+
+export type SessionInfoWithProfile = SessionInfo & {
+  profile?: AuthenticatedAccountProfile | null;
+};
+
+export interface AccountDisplay {
+  name: string;
+  secondary: string;
+  initials: string;
+  avatarUrl: string | null;
+  privateEmail: string | null;
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayForSession(session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null): AccountDisplay {
+  return accountDisplayFromSources({ session });
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayFromSources({
+  session,
+  account,
+}: {
+  session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  account?: AccountView | null;
+}): AccountDisplay {
+  const sessionWithProfile = session as SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  const profile = sessionWithProfile?.profile ?? null;
+  const privateEmail = normalizeEmail(profile?.email);
+  const handle = normalizeHandle(profile?.handle) ?? normalizeHandle(account?.account?.handle);
+  const displayName = normalizeDisplayName(profile?.displayName, privateEmail);
+  const did = sessionWithProfile?.did ?? account?.account?.did ?? null;
+  const name = displayName ?? handle ?? "Signed-in account";
+  const secondary = handle && handle !== name ? handle : shortenDid(did) ?? "Not Organic";
+
+  return {
+    name,
+    secondary,
+    initials: initialsFor(displayName ?? handle ?? did),
+    avatarUrl: safeAvatarUrl(profile?.avatarUrl),
+    privateEmail,
+  };
+}
+
+function normalizeDisplayName(value: unknown, email: string | null): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (email && text.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) return null;
+  if (looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeHandle(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value)?.replace(/^@+/, "");
+  if (!text || looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeEmail(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  return text && looksLikeEmail(text) ? text : null;
+}
+
+function normalizeText(value: unknown): string | null {
+  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null;
+}
+
+function safeAvatarUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.startsWith("/") && !text.startsWith("//")) return text;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(text);
+    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.toString() : null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function looksLikeEmail(value: string): boolean {
+  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
+}
+
+function initialsFor(value: string | null | undefined): string {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return "NO";
+  const words = text
+    .replace(/^did:\w+:/, "")
+    .split(/[\s._-]+/)
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  const first = words[0] ?? text;
+  const second = words.find((word) => word !== first);
+  return [first, second]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .map((word) => Array.from(word ?? "")[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
+    .join("")
+    .slice(0, 2) || "NO";
+}
+
+function shortenDid(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.length <= 24) return text;
+  return `${text.slice(0, 13)}...${text.slice(-6)}`;
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+import type { SessionInfo, AccountView } from "./api";
+
+export interface AuthenticatedAccountProfile {
+  displayName?: string | null;
+  handle?: string | null;
+  avatarUrl?: string | null;
+  email?: string | null;
+}
+
+export type SessionInfoWithProfile = SessionInfo & {
+  profile?: AuthenticatedAccountProfile | null;
+};
+
+export interface AccountDisplay {
+  name: string;
+  secondary: string;
+  initials: string;
+  avatarUrl: string | null;
+  privateEmail: string | null;
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayForSession(session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null): AccountDisplay {
+  return accountDisplayFromSources({ session });
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayFromSources({
+  session,
+  account,
+}: {
+  session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  account?: AccountView | null;
+}): AccountDisplay {
+  const sessionWithProfile = session as SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  const profile = sessionWithProfile?.profile ?? null;
+  const privateEmail = normalizeEmail(profile?.email);
+  const handle = normalizeHandle(profile?.handle) ?? normalizeHandle(account?.account?.handle);
+  const displayName = normalizeDisplayName(profile?.displayName, privateEmail);
+  const did = sessionWithProfile?.did ?? account?.account?.did ?? null;
+  const name = displayName ?? handle ?? "Signed-in account";
+  const secondary = handle && handle !== name ? handle : shortenDid(did) ?? "Not Organic";
+
+  return {
+    name,
+    secondary,
+    initials: initialsFor(displayName ?? handle ?? did),
+    avatarUrl: safeAvatarUrl(profile?.avatarUrl),
+    privateEmail,
+  };
+}
+
+function normalizeDisplayName(value: unknown, email: string | null): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (email && text.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) return null;
+  if (looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeHandle(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value)?.replace(/^@+/, "");
+  if (!text || looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeEmail(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  return text && looksLikeEmail(text) ? text : null;
+}
+
+function normalizeText(value: unknown): string | null {
+  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null;
+}
+
+function safeAvatarUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.startsWith("/") && !text.startsWith("//")) return text;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(text);
+    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.toString() : null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function looksLikeEmail(value: string): boolean {
+  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
+}
+
+function initialsFor(value: string | null | undefined): string {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return "NO";
+  const words = text
+    .replace(/^did:\w+:/, "")
+    .split(/[\s._-]+/)
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  const first = words[0] ?? text;
+  const second = words.find((word) => word !== first);
+  return [first, second]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .map((word) => Array.from(word ?? "")[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
+    .join("")
+    .slice(0, 2) || "NO";
+}
+
+function shortenDid(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.length <= 24) return text;
+  return `${text.slice(0, 13)}...${text.slice(-6)}`;
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+import type { SessionInfo, AccountView } from "./api";
+
+export interface AuthenticatedAccountProfile {
+  displayName?: string | null;
+  handle?: string | null;
+  avatarUrl?: string | null;
+  email?: string | null;
+}
+
+export type SessionInfoWithProfile = SessionInfo & {
+  profile?: AuthenticatedAccountProfile | null;
+};
+
+export interface AccountDisplay {
+  name: string;
+  secondary: string;
+  initials: string;
+  avatarUrl: string | null;
+  privateEmail: string | null;
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayForSession(session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null): AccountDisplay {
+  return accountDisplayFromSources({ session });
+}
+
+export function accountDisplayFromSources({
+  session,
+  account,
+}: {
+  session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  account?: AccountView | null;
+}): AccountDisplay {
+  const sessionWithProfile = session as SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
+  const profile = sessionWithProfile?.profile ?? null;
+  const privateEmail = normalizeEmail(profile?.email);
+  const handle = normalizeHandle(profile?.handle) ?? normalizeHandle(account?.account?.handle);
+  const displayName = normalizeDisplayName(profile?.displayName, privateEmail);
+  const did = sessionWithProfile?.did ?? account?.account?.did ?? null;
+  const name = displayName ?? handle ?? "Signed-in account";
+  const secondary = handle && handle !== name ? handle : shortenDid(did) ?? "Not Organic";
+
+  return {
+    name,
+    secondary,
+    initials: initialsFor(displayName ?? handle ?? did),
+    avatarUrl: safeAvatarUrl(profile?.avatarUrl),
+    privateEmail,
+  };
+}
+
+function normalizeDisplayName(value: unknown, email: string | null): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (email && text.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) return null;
+  if (looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeHandle(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value)?.replace(/^@+/, "");
+  if (!text || looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
+  return text;
+}
+
+function normalizeEmail(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  return text && looksLikeEmail(text) ? text : null;
+}
+
+function normalizeText(value: unknown): string | null {
+  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null;
+}
+
+function safeAvatarUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.startsWith("/") && !text.startsWith("//")) return text;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(text);
+    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.toString() : null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function looksLikeEmail(value: string): boolean {
+  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
+}
+
+function initialsFor(value: string | null | undefined): string {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return "NO";
+  const words = text
+    .replace(/^did:\w+:/, "")
+    .split(/[\s._-]+/)
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  const first = words[0] ?? text;
+  const second = words.find((word) => word !== first);
+  return [first, second]
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .map((word) => Array.from(word ?? "")[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
+    .join("")
+    .slice(0, 2) || "NO";
+}
+
+function shortenDid(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
+  const text = normalizeText(value);
+  if (!text) return null;
+  if (text.length <= 24) return text;
+  return `${text.slice(0, 13)}...${text.slice(-6)}`;
+}

# Impact Analysis with GitNexus

## When to Use

- "Is it safe to change this function?"
- "What will break if I modify X?"
- "Show me the blast radius"
- "Who uses this code?"
- Before making non-trivial code changes
- Before committing — to understand what your changes affect

## Bind the repository first

Impact analysis is the gate that authorizes an edit, so it must answer for the
repository you are about to edit.

Call `list_repos {}` before the first tool call. With one indexed repository,
use the examples below as written. With more than one, pass `repo` on every
call: an omitted `repo` normally errors, but under an MCP policy with a
configured default it resolves to that default silently. If you cannot tell
which repository is meant, stop and ask — every result below an ambiguous
identity inherits the ambiguity. `list_repos` is paginated, so page with
`offset: pagination.nextOffset` until `hasMore` is false before concluding a
repository is absent.

`detect_changes` takes `worktree` when your changes are in a linked worktree
the MCP server was not launched from. The server auto-detects a worktree only
when it was launched from inside one; otherwise `git diff` runs in the wrong
checkout and reports zero changed symbols — a false clean check that carries
none of the degradation flags described below. In the CLI fallbacks, `--repo .`
means the current checkout; pass the intended repository path instead when you
are not standing in it.

State the bound identity with your risk report:

```
Repository: <name> (<path>)   Worktree: <path>   Index: <commit>, <n> behind HEAD
```

## Workflow

```
0. list_repos {}                                           → Bind repo (and worktree)
1. impact({target: "X", direction: "upstream"}) or `node .gitnexus/run.cjs impact "X" --direction upstream --repo .`
2. READ gitnexus://repo/{name}/processes                   → Check affected execution flows
3. detect_changes({scope: "all"}) or `node .gitnexus/run.cjs detect-changes --scope all --repo .`
4. Assess risk and report to user, echoing repo/worktree/index identity
```

> If "Index is stale" → run `node .gitnexus/run.cjs analyze` in terminal.

## Checklist

```
- [ ] list_repos {} — bind repo; explicit repo when >1 indexed, ask if ambiguous
- [ ] impact({target, direction: "upstream"}) or CLI fallback to find dependents
- [ ] Review d=1 items first (these WILL BREAK)
- [ ] Check high-confidence (>0.8) dependencies
- [ ] READ processes to check affected execution flows
- [ ] detect_changes({scope: "all"}) or CLI fallback for pre-commit check

- [ ] Assess risk level and report, stating repo/worktree/index identity
```

## Understanding Output

| Depth | Risk Level       | Meaning                  |
| ----- | ---------------- | ------------------------ |
| d=1   | **WILL BREAK**   | Direct callers/importers |
| d=2   | LIKELY AFFECTED  | Indirect dependencies    |
| d=3   | MAY NEED TESTING | Transitive effects       |

## Risk Assessment

| Affected                       | Risk     |
| ------------------------------ | -------- |
| <5 symbols, few processes      | LOW      |
| 5-15 symbols, 2-5 processes    | MEDIUM   |
| >15 symbols or many processes  | HIGH     |
| Critical path (auth, payments) | CRITICAL |
| **Zero callers found**         | **UNKNOWN** |

callers are not resolvable by the index" (plain-object property access, dynamic

import type { SessionInfo, AccountView } from "./api";

export interface AuthenticatedAccountProfile {
  displayName?: string | null;
  handle?: string | null;
  avatarUrl?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
}

export type SessionInfoWithProfile = SessionInfo & {
  profile?: AuthenticatedAccountProfile | null;
};

export interface AccountDisplay {
  name: string;
  secondary: string;
  initials: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
  privateEmail: string | null;
}

export function accountDisplayForSession(session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null): AccountDisplay {
  return accountDisplayFromSources({ session });
}

export function accountDisplayFromSources({
  session,
  account,
}: {
  session: SessionInfo | SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
  account?: AccountView | null;
}): AccountDisplay {
  const sessionWithProfile = session as SessionInfoWithProfile | null;
  const profile = sessionWithProfile?.profile ?? null;
  const privateEmail = normalizeEmail(profile?.email);
  const handle = normalizeHandle(profile?.handle) ?? normalizeHandle(account?.account?.handle);
  const displayName = normalizeDisplayName(profile?.displayName, privateEmail);
  const did = sessionWithProfile?.did ?? account?.account?.did ?? null;
  const name = displayName ?? handle ?? "Signed-in account";
  const secondary = handle && handle !== name ? handle : shortenDid(did) ?? "Not Organic";

  return {
    name,
    secondary,
    initials: initialsFor(displayName ?? handle ?? did),
    avatarUrl: safeAvatarUrl(profile?.avatarUrl),
    privateEmail,
  };
}

function normalizeDisplayName(value: unknown, email: string | null): string | null {
  const text = normalizeText(value);
  if (!text) return null;
  if (email && text.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()) return null;
  if (looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
  return text;
}

function normalizeHandle(value: unknown): string | null {
  const text = normalizeText(value)?.replace(/^@+/, "");
  if (!text || looksLikeEmail(text)) return null;
  return text;
}

function normalizeEmail(value: unknown): string | null {
  const text = normalizeText(value);
  return text && looksLikeEmail(text) ? text : null;
}

function normalizeText(value: unknown): string | null {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : null;
}

function safeAvatarUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
  const text = normalizeText(value);
  if (!text) return null;
  if (text.startsWith("/") && !text.startsWith("//")) return text;
  try {
    const url = new URL(text);
    return url.protocol === "https:" || url.protocol === "http:" ? url.toString() : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function looksLikeEmail(value: string): boolean {
  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
}

function initialsFor(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  const text = normalizeText(value);
  if (!text) return "NO";
  const words = text
    .replace(/^did:\w+:/, "")
    .split(/[\s._-]+/)
    .filter(Boolean);
  const first = words[0] ?? text;
  const second = words.find((word) => word !== first);
  return [first, second]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((word) => Array.from(word ?? "")[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? "")
    .join("")
    .slice(0, 2) || "NO";
}

function shortenDid(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  const text = normalizeText(value);
  if (!text) return null;
  if (text.length <= 24) return text;
  return `${text.slice(0, 13)}...${text.slice(-6)}`;
}

function Wordmark() {

/**
 * Shows the typed handle back, shaped the way the system will read it.
 *
 * Sign-in is the step where people most often suspect they have mistyped
 * something, and the cost of being wrong is a confusing redirect to someone
 * else's provider. Echoing the input — with the initial in the avatar and the
 * normalised handle underneath — answers that doubt before they commit,

 *
 * It only claims to normalise, never to verify. The handle is not resolved

function HandleEcho({ handle }: { handle: string }) {
  const trimmed = handle.trim();
  const live = trimmed.length >= 3;

  const normalised = useMemo(() => {
    if (!live) return "";
    const value = trimmed.toLowerCase().replace(/^@/, "");
    // A DID is already canonical; anything else is a handle, and a bare name
    // with no dot is one the resolver will reject.
    if (value.startsWith("did:")) return value;
    return value;
  }, [trimmed, live]);

  const initial = live ? normalised.replace(/^did:\w+:/, "").charAt(0) : "?";

  return (
    <div className={live ? "handle-echo is-live" : "handle-echo"}>
      <span className="avatar" aria-hidden="true">
        <span>{initial}</span>
      </span>
      <span className="echo-text">
        <span className="echo-label">{live ? "Will sign in as" : "Waiting for a handle"}</span>
        <span className="echo-value">
          {live ? normalised : "you.pds.notorganic.info"}
        </span>
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useReveal } from "./juice";

export function Panel({
  title,
  eyebrow,
  children,
  wide,
  /** Position in the view, so sibling panels arrive in sequence. */

  eyebrow: string;

      {children}
    </section>

export function useOperation() {
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const run = async (operation: () => Promise<unknown>, success: string) => {
    setMessage("Working…");
    try {
      await operation();
      setMessage(success);
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Request failed");
    }
  };
  return { message, run, setMessage };
}

/** Loads once on mount and exposes a manual refresh. */
export function useLoader<T>(load: () => Promise<T>, deps: unknown[] = []) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      setData(await load());
      setError("");
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Request failed");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
    // `load` is redefined per render by callers; deps are supplied explicitly.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, deps);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, [refresh]);

  return { data, error, loading, refresh };
}

/** All money in this system is integer micro-USD; 1_000_000 = $1. */
export function usd(micros: number | undefined): string {
  return `$${((micros ?? 0) / 1_000_000).toFixed(4).replace(/0+$/, "").replace(/\.$/, ".00")}`;
}

/**
 * Two decimals, for the headline balance only.
 *
 * `usd` above keeps four, because a single metered request can cost a fraction
 * of a cent and rounding those away in the usage table would make the column
 * fail to add up. A headline figure has the opposite problem: it is animated,
 * and four decimals rolling at 60fps is an unreadable blur of digits. The
 * precise figures stay one line below it.
 */
export function usdRounded(micros: number | undefined): string {
  return `$${((micros ?? 0) / 1_000_000).toFixed(2)}`;
}

export function timestamp(value: number | undefined): string {
  if (!value) return "—";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleString();
}

export function duration(from: number | undefined, to: number | undefined): string {
  if (!from || !to || to < from) return "—";
  const seconds = Math.round((to - from) / 1000);
  return seconds < 60 ? `${seconds}s` : `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}m ${seconds % 60}s`;
}

/**
 * Product ids are stable machine values (`twyne`, `stich`) and plan ids carry
 * an underscore (`twyne_pro`). Neither is how the product is written down
 * anywhere else the customer has seen it — not on the invoice, not on the
 * marketing site, not in the app they bought it in. Printing the raw id here
 * makes the portal look like a database viewer and quietly asks the reader to
 * learn a second name for something they already know.
 */
const PRODUCT_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
  twyne: "Twyne",
  keating: "Keating",
  interleave: "Interleave",
  stich: "Stich",
  notorganic: "Not Organic",
};

export function productLabel(product: string): string {
  return PRODUCT_NAMES[product] ?? titleCase(product);
}

/** `twyne_pro` becomes "Twyne Pro", with the product's real capitalisation. */
export function planLabel(plan: string): string {
  const [head, ...rest] = plan.split("_");
  const product = head ? (PRODUCT_NAMES[head] ?? titleCase(head)) : "";
  return [product, ...rest.map(titleCase)].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

function titleCase(value: string): string {
  return value
    .split(/[_\s-]+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((word) => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))
    .join(" ");
}

/**
 * Status as a word rather than an enum. `past_due` is a state the reader is
 * being asked to act on, and PAST_DUE reads as a log line — something that
 * happened to the system — rather than something about their account.
 *
 * Tone is a scan aid only. The word inside the pill always carries the
 * meaning, so the state survives a monochrome render and does not depend on
 * the reader distinguishing amber from green.
 */
export function StatusPill({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const tone =
    status === "succeeded" || status === "active"
      ? "good"
      : status === "failed" || status === "expired" || status === "locked"
        ? "bad"
        : status === "cancelled"
          ? "muted"
          : "busy";
  return <span className={`pill pill-${tone}`}>{titleCase(status)}</span>;
}

export function Empty({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return <p className="empty">{children}</p>;
}

   This surface used to be a dark green dashboard with an amber

   takes the marketing site's palette, type, radii, and texture

/**
 * The customer-facing portal API.
 *
 * Every call is same-origin against the portal's own server, authenticated by
 * an httpOnly session cookie. There is deliberately no token handling here:

export class PortalApiError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, readonly status: number, readonly code?: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "PortalApiError";
  }
}

let csrfToken: string | null = null;

async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const method = (init?.method ?? "GET").toUpperCase();
  const response = await fetch(path, {
    ...init,
    credentials: "same-origin",
    headers: {
      accept: "application/json",
      ...(init?.body ? { "content-type": "application/json" } : {}),
      ...(method !== "GET" && csrfToken ? { "x-csrf-token": csrfToken } : {}),
      ...init?.headers,
    },
  });
  const text = await response.text();
  const payload = text ? (JSON.parse(text) as unknown) : null;
  if (!response.ok) {
    const error = (payload as { error?: { message?: string; code?: string } } | null)?.error;
    throw new PortalApiError(
      error?.message ?? `${response.status} ${response.statusText}`,
      response.status,
      error?.code,
    );
  }
  return payload as T;
}

export const portalApi = {
  /** Resolves to null when nobody is signed in, rather than throwing. */
  async session(): Promise<SessionInfo | null> {
    try {
      const session = await request<SessionInfo>("/api/session");
      csrfToken = session.csrfToken;
      return session;
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof PortalApiError && error.status === 401) return null;
      throw error;
    }
  },

  /** Returns the authorization URL the browser should navigate to. */
  async login(handle: string): Promise<string> {
    const { redirectUrl } = await request<{ redirectUrl: string }>("/api/auth/login", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ handle }),
    });
    return redirectUrl;
  },

  async signup(): Promise<string> {

      method: "POST",

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+      "https://cdn.notorganic.info/ada.webp",
+      "https://cdn.notorganic.info/ada.webp",
+    ),

+    shouldRenderAvatarImage(

@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+  "Assert the account name, handle, and initials are visible while private email text is absent.",
+];
+

+
+const browser = await chromium.launch({
+  channel: "chrome",
+  executablePath: "/usr/bin/google-chrome",
+});

+  viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 },
+  recordVideo: {
+    dir: outputDir,
+    size: { width: 1440, height: 900 },
+  },
+});
+const page = await context.newPage();
+

+  route.fulfill({

+    contentType: "application/json",
+    body: JSON.stringify({

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"

+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { expect, test } from "bun:test";

+  name: "Ada Lovelace",

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { expect, test } from "bun:test";
+import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
+import { AccountAvatar, shouldRenderAvatarImage } from "./account-avatar";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+const display: AccountDisplay = {
+  name: "Ada Lovelace",
+  secondary: "ada.notorganic.info",
+  initials: "AL",
+  avatarUrl: "https://cdn.notorganic.info/ada.webp",
+  privateEmail: null,
+};
+
+test("renders avatar images with no referrer and a sanitized accessible name", () => {
+  const markup = renderToStaticMarkup(<AccountAvatar display={display} />);
+
+  expect(markup).toContain('role="img"');
+  expect(markup).toContain('aria-label="Account avatar for Ada Lovelace"');
+  expect(markup).toContain('src="https://cdn.notorganic.info/ada.webp"');
+  expect(markup).toContain('referrerPolicy="no-referrer"');
+  expect(markup).not.toContain("private@example.test");
+});
+
+test("falls back to initials when an avatar source is absent or has failed", () => {
+  const fallback = renderToStaticMarkup(<AccountAvatar display={{ ...display, avatarUrl: null }} />);
+
+  expect(fallback).toContain(">AL<");
+  expect(fallback).not.toContain("<img");
+  expect(shouldRenderAvatarImage("https://cdn.notorganic.info/ada.webp", null)).toBe(true);
+  expect(
+    shouldRenderAvatarImage(
+      "https://cdn.notorganic.info/ada.webp",
+      "https://cdn.notorganic.info/ada.webp",
+    ),
+  ).toBe(false);
+  expect(
+    shouldRenderAvatarImage(
+      "https://cdn.notorganic.info/ada-v2.webp",
+      "https://cdn.notorganic.info/ada.webp",
+    ),
+  ).toBe(true);
+});

@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}

+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+import type { AccountDisplay } from "./account-display";
+
+type AvatarDisplay = Pick<AccountDisplay, "name" | "initials" | "avatarUrl">;
+
+export function shouldRenderAvatarImage(src: string | null, failedSrc: string | null): src is string {
+  return src !== null && src !== failedSrc;
+}
+
+export function AccountAvatar({
+  display,
+  large = false,
+}: {
+  display: AvatarDisplay;
+  large?: boolean;
+}) {
+  const [failedSrc, setFailedSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const src = display.avatarUrl;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setFailedSrc(null);
+  }, [src]);
+
+  const showImage = shouldRenderAvatarImage(src, failedSrc);
+  const className = large ? "account-avatar account-avatar-large" : "account-avatar";
+
+  return (
+    <span className={className} aria-label={`Account avatar for ${display.name}`} role="img">
+      {showImage ? (
+        <img
+          key={src}
+          src={src}
+          alt=""
+          decoding="async"
+          referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
+          onError={() => setFailedSrc(src)}
+        />
+      ) : (
+        <span>{display.initials}</span>
+      )}
+    </span>
+  );
+}
